Intros/outros are 2-bar one-shots at the parent cue's tempo (-22 LUFS target, same as the music); an intro ends on a handoff bell at the loop's first downbeat, an outro closes on the tonic pad + bell with a 0.5 s fade. The full flute tail stays reserved for the resolve stinger and rift_finale; hub / Thanh Lac outros use the low pluck tail, the thang_long precedent.

Phase layers are ADDITIVE loops at the parent cue's tempo/bars (-25 LUFS target): they play over the base cue, they do not replace it. Combined base+layer loudness/true-peak is measured from real bytes and recorded per layer.

Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the MD2 files are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files, their cue bindings, or the checkpoint-26/30/MD1 cues.

No ear audition has been done; loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes. Loop seams are recorded per looping cue in the delivery manifest: wrapJump after a disclosed 0.25 s end-landing loop construction, wrapJumpRaw before it.
